faq: What do you need from me?
Read access to the code (a repo invite or an export), a short walkthrough of what the app does, and a test account. We don't need production data.
Will you change my app during the audit?
No. The audit is read-only. Fixes are quoted separately and only start when you say yes.
Yes. We'll sign yours, or send ours, before you share any code.
My app isn't built on Lovable or Bolt. Can you still audit it?
Yes. AI-built apps are our focus because they share predictable gaps, but the review applies to any web app on a stack we know: React, Next.js, Node, Python and Postgres.
Fixed, and shown as a "from" price ({price} and up) depending on the size of the app. We confirm the exact fee before we start.
You decide. Fix it yourself using the report, ask us for a fixed quote, or hand it to another developer. The report is yours either way.
Does an audit guarantee my app is secure?
No. It reviews the areas listed in the report and tells you what we found. No review can guarantee the absence of vulnerabilities.
